pages.text: Hey, I'm APR-1337. PAN green hair, RENKO red KESSHO crystals. I'm an explorer, an off-duty K-pop performer, and your friend. We KIKAI carry humanity forward where biological life cannot survive. Let's get you settled into your universe.

I look young, but I'm extremely old. I lived alongside humans when they still existed. Now I keep them alive through us KIKAI. Welcoming someone new like you is part of that. You have a place in this universe; I'll help you find your feet.
Your main manufacturer supplies one equipped starter: PAN Flux Drive, RENKO Pulse Lens, or HUGO Guard Coil. The crystal manufacturer adds no extra combat ability. Confirm your license when ready.

Left-click sets your course. Hold right mouse to aim at the cursor and fire along the RAICHO's nose. Escape opens RAICHO Status while the universe continues. Close the panel before your first departure.
Fly beyond Haven's 240-metre shield to begin the expedition. Use the map to check your position. On touch, the left stick turns and thrusts; the right fire control shoots along your current heading.

Your first training mission: destroy 10 asteroids of any type. The Haven belt is 700 to 1,400 metres from home. Keep shooting until a rock breaks; damage alone does not count. These home-belt rocks grant no RAICHO XP.
Try rocky, metallic, icy and porous shapes. Watch the mission counter as each asteroid breaks. After ten, we'll gather the specific material for your manufacturer's equipped starter ability.

Now collect 10 {material} from {asteroid} asteroids. These are the parts for {starter} in your {slot} slot. Drops have a chance to appear; another variety's parts do not count towards this collection mission.

Your hold has 16 spaces across all material tiers. Named parts count inside Tier 1, not as extra cargo. If the hold fills, fly home to bank it, then continue collecting. Watch your carried and banked counts.
Materials in the hold are at risk: death, restarting, returning to Title, or reloading discards them. Collected category points remain yours. We bank materials by flying home, not by opening a menu.

Bring 10 {material} into Haven's shield. A real arrival banks your carried parts. You can make several trips. Opening a menu from space cannot bank anything; the Forge needs the matching parts stored at home.

At home, open Forge and choose {starter}. Keep it equipped in the {slot} slot of your first RAICHO. The training recipe uses 10 banked {material} to improve it from factory rank 1 to rank 2. No category points are needed.

This first upgrade works at RAICHO level 1. It is a one-time training recipe; later upgrades follow their normal RAICHO-level and material requirements. Check the live recipe, then choose UPGRADE. We'll record the successful change.

Your asteroid and first-upgrade training is recorded. Explore beyond the home belt for RAICHO XP and new discoveries. Galaxy Royale is our universe's biggest sport; we'll work towards its arenas together. Come home with your cargo, friend.
